    int mult(int a, int b) {

    int mult(int a, int b, int c) {
        return mult(mult(a, b), c);
    }

    int mult(const std::vector<int>& x) {
        int r = 1;
        for (int y : x) {
            r = mult(r, y);
        }
        return r;
    }

    std::vector<std::vector<int>> stirling;

    void prepareStirling() {
        int size = 5001;
        stirling.assign(size, std::vector<int>(size, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            stirling[i][0] = 0;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            stirling[i][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                stirling[i][j] = add(mult(stirling[i - 1][j], i - 1), stirling[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    void run(std::istream& in, std::ostream& out) {
        prepareStirling();
        int n, m, k;
        in >> n >> m >> k;
        long long invm = 1;
        {
            long long a = m, m_mod = mod;
            long long b = m, m_mod2 = mod;
            long long x0 = 0, x1 = 1;
            while (b != 0) {
                long long q = a / b;
                long long tmp = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = tmp;
                long long tmpx = x0 - q * x1;
                x0 = x1;
                x1 = tmpx;
            }
            invm = (x0 % mod + mod) % mod;
        }
        std::vector<int> pVal(k + 1, 0);
        pVal[0] = 1;
        int currentN = n;
        int prod = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {

            currentN--;

            for (int j = i - 1; j >= 1; j--) {

                sumVal = add(sumVal, mult(stirling[i][j], add(0, sign * pVal[j])));
            }
            pVal[i] = sumVal;
        }
        out << pVal[k] << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    Task t;
    t.run(std::cin, std::cout);
    return 0;
